prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the parking lot collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was properly stopped in a marked parking space when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The collision was entirely avoidable. Your insured failed to check for pedestrians and vehicles behind him before reversing, and the resulting impact caused our client's body to be thrown sharply against the seatbelt and seat frame.

Our client was subsequently diagnosed with a lumbar strain and soft tissue injuries to the lower back. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, physical therapy, and prescribed medication. Our client has missed several days of work and continues to experience pain that limits lifting, prolonged sitting, and ordinary household activities. Medical records and billing statements documenting these treatments are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured admitted at the scene that he did not see our client's vehicle. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law.
